required_stages.description: Allocate Y with X's shape/dtype inside run().
Single logical pass (any split across programs or launches, no global intermediate): Y = X if X > 0 else 0.01 * X, each X element read once and each Y element written once by the algorithm.

forbidden_substitutions.message: library leaky ReLU computes the operator
PyTorch elementwise computation of the result
in-place PyTorch arithmetic on the input

required_evidence.message: a device-side select between x and 0.01*x

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh tensor with X's shape/dtype allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: Measured: the GPU time of all device work run() launches on every call (kernels, fills, copies, casts, repacks). Host-side work in run() (the output allocation, metadata reads, Python) is not GPU time. No casts, copies or cross-call caches.
